Values at the average prices of the year

Source: R/cp_pi2cy.R
cp_pi2cy.Rd

Quarterly (or monthly) values of each period valued at the weighted average prices of its own year (the column "Current Year's Prices" of the example 8.7 of the IMF QNA Manual). They are used by the one-quarter overlap technique: the overlap period is valued at the average prices of the year, and not at its own current prices.

Usage

cp_pi2cy(cp, pi)

Arguments

cp

Current prices (ts or mts).

pi

Price indices over the previous year (previous year average = 100), with the same structure as cp.

Value

A ts (or mts) with the structure of cp (extended to complete years). It is NA for the years without price indices (e.g. the reference year).

Details

The value is the volume measure at the prices of the previous year, multiplied by the annual price index of the year \(y\) (the annual current prices divided by the annual sum of the volume measures at the prices of the previous year, see pi_annual()): $$cy_t = \frac{100\, cp_t}{pi_t} \times \frac{pi_y}{100}, \qquad pi_y = 100 \times \frac{\sum_{q \in y} cp_q}{\sum_{q \in y} 100\, cp_q / pi_q},$$ so that the annual sum of \(cy_t\) is the annual current price value.

References

International Monetary Fund (2018), Quarterly National Accounts Manual (2017 Edition), chapter 8 "Price and Volume Measures", Washington, DC. doi:10.5089/9781475589870.069 .

See also

chain_laspeyres(), chain_contrib(), pi_annual()

Examples

cp_pi2cy(imf_cp, imf_pi)
#>                A        B
#> 2010 Q1       NA       NA
#> 2010 Q2       NA       NA
#> 2010 Q3       NA       NA
#> 2010 Q4       NA       NA

#> 2011 Q4 169.0949 210.6333

#> 2012 Q3 190.2484 191.9827
